verdict.rationale: Base44 explicitly supports event/schedule-based workflows ('A workflow runs on a schedule or when a trigger happens, such as activity in a connected tool') and AI agents that 'update records, trigger workflows, and connect to tools' automatically in response to chat/events, matching the automation-depth story. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of rule complexity (e.g., conditional logic beyond simple triggers) and no third-party corroboration of workflow reliability.
